services.name: Dog Grooming Service Variation 1
services.description: Professional dog grooming service for the health and happiness of your pet.
included: Service execution by certified pet professional

process_steps.title: Pet Assessment
process_steps.description: Evaluating the pet's breed, temperament, and specific needs

process_steps.title: Service Preparation
process_steps.description: Preparing equipment and a safe environment

process_steps.title: Service Execution
process_steps.description: Delivering the requested pet care service

process_steps.title: Post-Service Check
process_steps.description: Ensuring the pet is comfortable and healthy post-service

process_steps.title: Owner Handover & Tips
process_steps.description: Briefing the owner on aftercare and next steps

customer_setup: Ensure pet has been fed at least 2 hours before grooming
Provide vaccination records if applicable
Keep a calm environment during the visit
aftercare: Monitor pet behaviour for 24 hours post-service
Follow any dietary or medication advice given
services.expected_results: A clean, healthy, and happy pet with improved coat and behaviour.
services.important_notes: Aggressive pets may require additional handling precautions — please disclose temperament.
services.warranty: Free re-service if quality standards are not met on first visit.

faqs.question: Do you handle all breeds?
faqs.answer: Yes, our professionals are trained to handle all dog and cat breeds.

faqs.question: Are the products pet-safe?
faqs.answer: Absolutely — we only use vet-approved, non-toxic products.

faqs.question: Can you handle anxious pets?
faqs.answer: Yes, our groomers are trained in gentle handling for anxious animals.

faqs.question: Do you offer mobile pet grooming?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer in-home mobile grooming services.

dos: Share your pet's medical history with the professional before each visit.
donts: Do not bathe your dog immediately before a grooming appointment.
tips: Regular grooming every 4-6 weeks keeps your pet's coat healthy.
